mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months, as measured by the FEDFUNDS series, indicates monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and depresses valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that accelerates inflation expectations and triggers aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 295.0), the Federal Reserve implements aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 295.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where HOUST trends upward, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that fuels inflation and prompts aggressive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal excessive consumer demand that accelerates inflation and triggers monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), industrial production contraction signals potential recession risks that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.
